any_charge_returned.value: Growth variant: all mortality charges (excluding extra mortality and taxes) and all premium allocation charges returned at maturity as units; not on surrender, discontinued or paid-up policies

death_benefit_formula.value: highest of: sum assured less partial withdrawals in the 2 years before death; 105% of premiums paid; fund value (incl. loyalty additions)
death_benefit_formula.quote: The Death Benefit will be highest of: 1. Sum Assured* less Partial Withdrawals made in the two-year period immediately preceding the date of death of Life Insured. 2. 105% of all premiums paid as on date of death.

maturity_benefit.value: fund value (Growth: incl. RoMC, RoPAC, wealth boosters; Legacy: incl. loyalty additions, wealth boosters); settlement option available
maturity_benefit.quote: At maturity, the Policyholder may also choose to avail of the Settlement Option.

Legacy.when: end of each policy year from year 10 to one year before maturity

loyalty_additions.quote: Loyalty Additions will be credited to the Policy at the end of each Policy Year starting from the end of tenth Policy Year till one year before the date of maturity.
loyalty_additions.note: not credited after the policy becomes paid-up

value.at maturity: 1.25% of policy fund value (Growth: before adding back RoMC and RoPAC)

value.Growth: total mortality charges deducted over the term (excluding extra mortality and taxes), credited at maturity

return_of_mortality_charges.quote: the total amount of Mortality charges (excluding any extra Mortality charge & or any applicable tax/cess levied) and total Premium Allocation Charges (excluding any applicable tax/cess levied) deducted during the Policy Term will be credited to the Policy at maturity.

value.Growth: total premium allocation charges deducted over the term (excluding taxes), credited at maturity

return_of_premium_allocation_charges.quote: the total amount of Mortality charges (excluding any extra Mortality charge & or any applicable tax/cess levied) and total Premium Allocation Charges (excluding any applicable tax/cess levied) deducted during the Policy Term will be credited to the Policy at maturity.

return_of_policy_admin_charges.note: only mortality and allocation charges are returned

fund_switching.value: unlimited free; minimum 5% of fund value in any allocated fund
fund_switching.quote: The Policyholder is entitled to make any number of Switches in a Policy Year free of charge.

premium_redirection.value: allowed after the first policy year
premium_redirection.quote: can be modified only after the first Policy Year by submitting the Investment Fund Allocation Instruction.

partial_withdrawals.value: after the 5-year lock-in; minimum Rs 5,000; fund value must stay at least 120% of one annualised premium (25% of single premium); not before the minor life insured is 18
partial_withdrawals.quote: i. The minimum partial withdrawal limit is Rs 5,000.

systematic_withdrawal_plan.value: Legacy only: annual SWP from year 10, up to one annualised premium per year, minimum Rs 5,000 per instalment; can opt out once
systematic_withdrawal_plan.quote: SWP (Systematic Withdrawal Plan): is an automated partial withdrawal facility which can be opted by the Policyholder under Legacy Variant.

top_up_premiums.note: policy bond and brochure do not mention top-ups

settlement_option.value: fund value as lump sum, instalments over up to 5 years after maturity, or a combination; apply 90 days before maturity
settlement_option.quote: Settlement Period is the period not exceeding five years commencing from the date of maturity and is an option available to the Policyholder at maturity.

policy_loan.quote: 12. Loan There is no provision of loan on the Policy.

value.name: Dynamic Fund Allocation
value.mechanics: premiums go to Grow Money Plus Fund; over the last 5 years funds move to Steady Money Fund (80/20, 75/25, 70/30, 50/50, 0/100); inception only; can opt out once

value.name: Systematic Transfer Plan
value.mechanics: annual premium goes to Safe Money Fund, then 1/(13 - month) of units move monthly to Grow Money Plus Fund; annual mode only; no switch charge

auto_portfolio_strategies.quote: At inception of the Policy, the Policyholder may also choose to allocate the premium/s in one of the Investment strategies as per the conditions of the Product, with a maximum of two Investment strategies being available.

fund_count.value: 8 funds plus the Discontinued Policy Fund
fund_count.quote: The Investment Funds currently offered under the Policy by the Company are - Growth Opportunities Plus Fund, Grow Money Plus Fund, Save’n’grow Money Fund, Steady Money Fund, Safe Money Fund, Build India Fund, Stability Plus Money Fund and Emerging Equity Fund.
